text: FIX `incrementalModify()`, `incrementalPatch()`, `incrementalUpdate()` and `incrementalRemove()` wrote to an already deleted document and emitted additional `DELETE` events instead of rejecting with `DOC11`/`DOC13` like `modify()`, `patch()` and `remove()`. The deleted check now runs once in the incremental write queue, so `incrementalModify()` and `incrementalPatch()` of a deleted `RxLocalDocument` reject with `DOC11` too. `incrementalUpsert()` and `upsertLocal()` still insert a deleted document again
